description: Representative parameter setting used for multi-seed statistical validation, component ablation, stronger-baseline check, and additional service-quality and movement-control metrics.

regional_partition.description: The service space is divided into grid-based regional nodes.

notes: All compared algorithms should use the same generated online scenario under the same random seed.
The real task locations are kept fixed in each run.
The simulated worker set, worker locations, worker availability slots, and online arrival slots are regenerated under the corresponding random seed.
